dct_description_sm:
The City's Water and Drainage Division operates and maintains current infrastructure to ensure required service levels are provided. It also oversees the planning, design and construction of the citywide drainage system.  Data will include active, inactive and abandoned mains, as well as information on the main diameter, material, and the associated drawing name. Dataset updated continuously.  Click the Download button to access the entire Storm dataset.

Note the INVERT_IN_Z refers to the Downstream elevation of the main. INVERT_OUT_Z refers to the upstream elevation of the main.
